public_holidays: 2027-03-26: Good Friday (official: half-day state holiday under KRS 18A.190)
2027-12-24: Christmas Day observed (official: Friday, as 25 December is a Saturday)
Official note: Presidential election day is a state holiday under KRS 18A.190; 2027 has none. The Governor also designates one extra day with New Year's Day and one with Christmas.
culture-cycles.note: The extra days are set by the Governor each year; check the Personnel Cabinet memo for them.

items.text: Visiting qualified patients (non-residents or residents under 30 days, aged 21 or over, with a valid out-of-state registry card and proof of a qualifying diagnosis) can apply for a Kentucky card (US$25, valid one year). They may buy a 10-day supply in any 8-day period and carry up to a 10-day supply, kept in the dispensary's original container, with their card and documents. Smoking raw plant material is prohibited.

events.what: Kentucky general election, Tuesday 2 November 2027: governor and lieutenant governor, plus the other statewide offices on the 2027 cycle.
events.effect: Election day; polls and political signage are heavy in the days before. Voter registration books close in the weeks before (see the State Board's calendar).
